This directory contains the FreeType gray rasterizer distributed with Qt 4.4.3.
Its original copyright and FreeType Project License headers are retained.
The accompanying FTL.TXT is the unmodified upstream license.

OpenVector changes to qgrayraster.c:
- Replace setjmp/longjmp pool exhaustion with an explicit worker overflow flag.
  The original band subdivision and retry remain the error recovery mechanism.
- Remove unused allocating raster constructors/destructors and the function
  table. The freestanding wrapper supplies the raster object and memory pool.
- The allocator retains the observed x86 reference's 3200-byte control quota
  independently of the modified worker layout. This preserves pool-growth
  retries and any pixels already composed before those retries.
- Remove unused stdio/stdlib includes and nonlocal-jump declarations.

The two private headers and FTL.TXT match the official Qt 4.4.3 archive byte
for byte. source-identity.json records the archive URL and digest, upstream
member paths, and upstream and modified file digests. No Qt application or
widget code is included.

All rights reserved.
